jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
We are looking for a Brand Manager to strengthen the market presence of Hitachi and YORK brands in Türkiye and support their growth within the Bosch Home Comfort Türkiye portfolio.

  • Develop and implement brand strategies for Hitachi and YORK in alignment with business objectives and global brand guidelines.
  • Strengthen brand positioning, awareness and equity through market, customer and competitor insights.
  • Plan and execute integrated marketing and communication activities, including digital campaigns, PR, social media, events and sponsorships.
  • Ensure consistent brand identity and communication across all relevant channels and customer touchpoints.
  • Support product launches, go-to-market strategies and brand activation initiatives in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
  • Manage external agencies, business partners and marketing budgets to ensure effective execution of brand activities.
  • Monitor brand performance and campaign effectiveness through relevant KPIs and drive continuous improvement.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communication or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of professional experience in brand management, marketing or marketing communications.
  • Strong knowledge of brand strategy, positioning, digital marketing and integrated marketing communications.
  • Experience in managing marketing campaigns, external agencies and cross-functional projects.
  • Strong analytical thinking, creativity, communication and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple brands, stakeholders and priorities effectively.
  • Very good command of written and spoken English.
  • Experience in HVAC or other technical B2B/B2C industries is an advantage.
